display.title: Language and display
display.description: Your language follows you on every device. The theme is kept on this device.

password.title: Password
password.description: A new password signs out every other device where you are signed in.
password.newHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember. Do not use your name or email.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.description: After the password, sign-in asks for a code from an app on your phone (two-factor).
authenticator.required: Your role needs an authenticator app. Until you set it up, you can open only this page.
authenticator.requiredOn: Your role needs it, so it cannot be switched off.
authenticator.scan: 1. Scan this code with your authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. No camera? Type the key under the code into the app.
authenticator.qrLabel: QR code that adds Nexus Factory to your authenticator app
authenticator.enter: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows.
authenticator.codesBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once instead of the app. They are shown only now: copy or print them, or write them down, and keep them somewhere safe.
authenticator.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the codes and copy them.
authenticator.recoveryLow: Few recovery codes are left. Switch the app off and on again to get 10 new ones.
authenticator.turnedOn: The authenticator app is on. Sign-in now asks for its code.
authenticator.disableBody: Enter your password to switch the authenticator app off. Your recovery codes stop working.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Where you are signed in now.
sessions.others: The list of your other devices comes later. To sign out everywhere else now, change your password.

qr.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it.
qr.tooLong: This is too long for a QR code.

field.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits the app shows.
field.passwordName: Do not use your name or email in the password.
field.repeatMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

problem.wrongPassword: The password is not right. After several wrong tries the account is locked for a few minutes.
problem.wrongCode: The code does not match. Check that the phone's clock is right, then enter the current code.
problem.locked: Too many wrong tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries from this device. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
problem.passwordRefused: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another.
problem.changed: Something changed meanwhile. Load the page again and repeat.
problem.unavailable: Nexus Factory is not answering. Try again in a moment.
problem.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
